note: claude-opus-5-5、入力 9438 / 出力 8309 トークン

data.assessment: Service is near its ceiling this period: 272.6 of 274.6 orders were on time, unfinished is 0.0, p95_wait_s is 90 and max_wait_s is 212. Only about 2 orders are late, mostly at pickup (1.8), so any rule change can gain at most about 2 on the main goal, close to the 1.0 minimum. The remaining friction is on the road. A never parks on the road but is blocked for 516 s and has all of its 1.8 late deliveries. B and C park and carry the sanctions (release overstays 14.0, blocking_guard evictions 15.6). C's utility (68.8) remains lowest, so the D1 commitment to mitigate C is still open.

proposals.title: hold_limit 60s -> 50s (shorter road parking to cut blocking of A)
proposals.rationale: A has 516 blocked seconds and all of its 1.8 late pickups while waiting on the road 0 times, so the remaining lateness appears to come from B/C robots parked on the road. Shortening the allowed hold from 60 s to 50 s aims to release node 8 sooner, which would lower blocked_s and recover some of the roughly 2 late orders, with p95/max wait unchanged or slightly better. Headroom is only about 2 orders, so the +1.0 objective gate may not be met. A is expected to vote yes; B and C will likely vote no because their overstay penalties rise. Adopting it would again cost C, which D2/D3 said should not happen without a clear customer gain.
proposals.cadl:
# =====================================================================
# robot_town.cadl ─── ロボットの街：3 社の配送ロボットが道路を共有する
#
# 道路網はラズパイマウスのシミュレータと同じ 11 ノード・17 エッジ。
# 3 社（A / B / C）が 2 台ずつロボットを走らせ、ノードは 1 台ずつしか
# 使えない。仕事のないロボットは車庫に戻るか、道路上（中央の交差点 8）
# に止まって次の注文を待つ。止まったロボットは他社の通行をふさぐ。
#
# `# @amend:<名前>` が付いた行は、改正してよいパラメータ。どの層（規則・
# 契約）に属し、どこまで動かしてよいかは constitution.yaml が決める。
# 委員会（COUNCIL）が自分で改正できるのは規則の層だけで、契約の層を
# 変えるには人間の判断が要る。
# =====================================================================

sos:
  name: "RobotTown"
  type: Collaborative             # 独立した 3 社が共通の規則を決める
  version: "1.0.0"

  context:
    environment:
      num_robots:   6
      num_companies: 3
      time_step_ms: 1000

  actors:
    - id: TOWN_STEWARD
      role: "road_steward"
      autonomy: low
      capabilities: [assign_order, record_violation, evict]
      interface:
        input:  [order_request, position_report, node_released, rule_update]
        output: [order_assignment, eviction_notice, regime_notice, violation_report]

    - id: "ROBOT[1..N]"
      role: "delivery_robot"
      autonomy: high
      capabilities: [move, park, pickup, dropoff]
      interface:
        input:  [order_assignment, eviction_notice, regime_notice, amendment_proposal]
        output: [position_report, node_released, ballot]

    - id: COUNCIL
      role: "rule_amendment_body"
      autonomy: medium
      capabilities: [propose_amendment, tally_ballots]
      interface:
        input:  [violation_report, ballot]
        output: [amendment_proposal, rule_update]

  contracts:
    # ── 顧客への約束：注文 1 件ごとのインスタンス（契約の層。人間が決める） ──
    - id: DELIVERY_SLA
      parties: [TOWN_STEWARD, "ROBOT[*]"]
      guarantee:
        - "pickup_time <= 120s"         # @amend:pickup_deadline
        - "dropoff_time <= 120s"        # @amend:dropoff_deadline
      lifecycle:
        states: [Assigned, PickedUp, Delivered, Late]
        initial: Assigned
        terminal: [Delivered, Late]
        transitions:
          - id: pickup
            from: Assigned
            to:   PickedUp
            on:   "ROBOT[i].status == PickedUp"
            deadline: 120s            # @amend:pickup_deadline
            on_violation: { transition: Late, severity: Major }
          - id: dropoff
            from: PickedUp
            to:   Delivered
            on:   "ROBOT[i].status == Delivered"
            deadline: 120s            # @amend:dropoff_deadline
            on_violation: { transition: Late, severity: Major }

    # ── 道路の使い方：道路上に止まるたびに 1 インスタンス ──
    - id: ROAD_USE
      parties: [TOWN_STEWARD, "ROBOT[*]", COUNCIL]
      guarantee:
        - "hold_time <= hold_limit"
      authority:
        decision_holder: COUNCIL
        beta: 0.5
        mode: "collective"
      information:
        alpha: 1.0                    # 規則と違反記録は全社に公開
      incentives:
        type: sanction
        lambda: 0.5                   # @amend:sanction_lambda
        rules:
          - "penalty(ROBOT[i], lambda) when overstay"
      lifecycle:
        states: [Holding, Overstay, Released, Evicted]
        initial: Holding
        terminal: [Released, Evicted]
        transitions:
          - id: release
            from: [Holding, Overstay]
            to:   Released
            on:   "ROBOT[i] -> TOWN_STEWARD : node_released"
            deadline: 50s             # @amend:hold_limit
            on_violation: { transition: Overstay, severity: Minor }
      monitors:
        - id: blocking_guard
          observe: "ROBOT[i].blocking"
          sampling: periodic(1000ms)
          rule: "ROBOT.blocking >= 2 AND state IN [Holding, Overstay]"  # @amend:block_k
          on_match: { transition: Evicted, severity: Major }

  # ── 運用モード：分散（各社が道路上で待つ）⇄ 集中（管理者が待避所を割り当てる） ──
  # 条件は 5 分ごとに、直前 5 分の観測で判定する。
  #   orders_in_window : 3 社の注文の合計件数
  #   blocked_pct      : ロボットが止まっているロボットにふさがれていた時間の割合（%）
  # 集中管理は交差点をふさがれない反面、エッジを 1 台ずつ割り当てるので、
  # 注文が非常に多いと許可待ちが積み重なる。そのときだけ分散に戻す。
  transitions:
    - from: DISTRIBUTED
      to: CENTRALIZED
      condition: "orders_in_window < 22"      # @amend:to_central
      protocol: SWITCH
      safety_invariant: "robots_on_road == 0"
    - from: CENTRALIZED
      to: DISTRIBUTED
      condition: "orders_in_window >= 26"     # @amend:to_distributed
      protocol: SWITCH

  protocols:
    - id: SWITCH
      trigger: "regime_condition_holds"
      steps:
        - "TOWN_STEWARD -> ROBOT[*] : regime_notice"
        - "ROBOT[*] -> TOWN_STEWARD : node_released"
        - "TOWN_STEWARD : activate_regime"
    - id: AMEND
      trigger: "period_end"
      steps:
        - "TOWN_STEWARD -> COUNCIL : violation_report"
        - "COUNCIL -> ROBOT[*] : amendment_proposal"
        - "ROBOT[*] -> COUNCIL : ballot"
        - "COUNCIL : tally_ballots"
        - "COUNCIL -> TOWN_STEWARD : rule_update"

  metrics:
    - id: on_time_deliveries
      formula: "count(Delivered)"
      target: ">= 0.9 * count(orders)"
    - id: blocked_time
      formula: "sum(blocked_robot_seconds)"
      target: "<= 600s"
assumptions: The 14.0 release overstays and most blocking of A come from B/C robots parked at node 8.
Robots respond to a shorter hold deadline by leaving the road earlier, rather than simply collecting more Minor violations.
unknowns: Whether hold_limit changes robot behaviour or only how violations are counted and sanctioned.
Whether A's 1.8 late pickups are caused by blocking or by rush-hour order density.
Per-seed spread of the gain, given a headroom of only about 2 orders.

predictions.subject: metric:on_time_deliveries
predictions.note: Small at most (<=2); may fall short of the +1.0 gate.

predictions.subject: metric:road_violations
predictions.note: More holds exceed the shorter 50 s limit.

predictions.subject: metric:p95_wait_s
predictions.note: Tail waits already near the floor.

predictions.subject: vote:A
predictions.note: A parks 0 times and gains from less blocking.

predictions.subject: vote:C
predictions.note: C already carries the largest penalty, 21.4.

proposals.title: hold_limit 60s -> 70s (measured mitigation candidate for C)
proposals.rationale: C's utility (68.8) is lowest because of penalties (21.4) from release overstays (14.0) and blocking evictions; D1 and D3 promised a mitigation for C, to be measured on the same seeds. Lengthening the allowed hold to 70 s should cut release overstays and raise B's and C's utility. It may add some blocking for A, so on_time_deliveries is expected to stay flat or dip slightly and is unlikely to pass the +1.0 gate. B and C are expected to vote yes and A no. The main value of this proposal is the same-seed measurement of the mitigation, which the human asked for.
